response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_pressratio), AVG(avg_gbsize_per_spanmin) FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, st.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) as avg_pressratio, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) as avg_gbsize_per_spanmin FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.typesite) grouped_data
